correctness.rationale: An explicit basepoint-free (2,2) morphism is finite degree eight. Its Jacobian ramification divisor has bidegree (4,4). Smoothness for general complex parameters is established through a full four-chart nonvanishing certificate modulo 101. A local analysis at each type of coordinate-axis preimage gives exactly four double-contact and eight transverse critical points, and the twelve distinct target coordinates on the same witness. Projection formula forces degree 16 and birationality on ramification. Adjunction and arithmetic genus prove the genus and delta sum. No finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The degree-eight two-conic map is a natural first nonlinear Hadamard example. Its irreducible branch curve, normalization genus, total delta and exact axis-cycle with four double contacts give structural information on a complete natural covering, not an arbitrary finite slice. These concrete properties can guide analysis of off-axis branch singularities and degenerations.
